items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: we used to have King Oliver at that time was making records... And that's how we used to learn how to play about getting King Oliver's records.

ctx.x: You see? Oh, John didn't stay with the band? How long was John in the band?
Well, John stayed with the band until Allen went off. Like I said, you see, when Allen first left, yeah, Allen met with King Oliver, you see,
Oliver's sentence for him. He was on the boat at the time.
